integrity: The stated results are supported by a written analytic proof and a finite, reproducible, standard-library numerical diagnostic; the diagnostic is not a proof of uniqueness or infinite-energy behavior. No independent scientific validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the conservative piecewise-cubic subfamily with \(c,d_+,d_->0\). It does not address general switching polynomial systems, perturbations, or cyclicity; big-O expansions are for fixed parameters and the contrast limit fixes \(c,d_-\). Publication priority outside the inspected sources has not been established.
title: Monotone residence exchange and a quartic crossover law in a switching nilpotent center
